name: Fullerton Joint Union High School District
orgTypeBasis: A California public school district; its own site lists the eight campuses it operates and the CDE school directory carries it as an active local educational agency.
whyTheyFit: One district office on Bastanchury sits above eight secondary campuses - Sonora, Fullerton Union, La Habra, Buena Park, Sunny Hills, Troy, the La Sierra/La Vista alternative pair and the iSierra online academy - so a single approved district vendor agreement negotiated here is the paperwork that lets every one of those ASB accounts issue a purchase order without starting over, and the district publishes named administrator emails on the state directory rather than hiding behind a form.
buyingWindow: Aug-Oct (vendor approval and district purchasing setup), then Feb-Jun as each campus books
headcountBasis: A GROUP SIZE, not the district. The event the district office itself buys is a cabinet or classified staff-appreciation night of roughly 40-120; the 11,000-14,000 students across its eight secondary campuses are the reason to hold the vendor agreement, not the guest list. Both figures are estimates.
note: This row is a paperwork play, not an event booking. The district office does not buy grad nights; it approves who may sell to the eight campuses that do. Estimated enrolment 11,000-14,000 across those campuses. The published address is the superintendent, not the business office. The CDE record also carries an Assistant Superintendent, Business Services address, which is the better seat for a vendor agreement once the door is open.
addressSource: District website homepage and CDE School Directory record 30665140000000, both read 14 August 2026

name: Sonora High School
orgTypeBasis: A comprehensive public high school operated by Fullerton Joint Union High School District and listed in the CDE school directory.
address: 401 S Palm St, La Habra, CA 90631
whyTheyFit: Sonora runs seven separate named pathways off one campus - an Academy of Nursing and Medical Careers, Agriculture, Culinary Arts, Arts Manufacturing Production, a Dual Language Academy, IB and JROTC - and each of those cohorts holds its own end-of-year banquet or induction rather than folding into a single class night, which turns one high school into six or seven bookable groups of forty to a hundred spread across the spring.
buyingWindow: May-Jun (grad night and pathway banquets), Feb-Mar (JROTC and IB recognition)
headcountBasis: Per-pathway cohort estimate from the seven programs the school names on its own homepage; the senior class as a whole is several hundred. Estimate only.
note: The published administrator email is the principal's, from the state directory. The school's own administration and staff-directory pages carry a noindex header and could not be read, so the named activities contact still has to be got by phone or in person.
addressSource: School homepage and CDE School Directory record 30665143037090, both read 14 August 2026

name: La Habra High School
orgTypeBasis: A comprehensive public high school operated by Fullerton Joint Union High School District, with its own site under the district's school list.
address: 801 W Highlander Ave, La Habra, CA 90631
whyTheyFit: La Habra's ASB page prints one instruction - that any specific question about events at the school goes to the ASB Director by email - which means this campus has already published a single named door for exactly the conversation a grad-night sale starts with, and it is three and a third miles from the venue.

name: Fullerton Union High School
orgTypeBasis: A comprehensive public high school operated by Fullerton Joint Union High School District; address and principal contact are printed on the school's own principal page.
whyTheyFit: Fullerton Union splits its administration four ways and names one of the four Assistant Principal of Student Affairs, which is the seat that owns dances, class events and the ASB calendar here, and the campus sits on Chapman in downtown Fullerton with its own booster-club structure listed beside the ASB site - a school where the buyer is a defined job rather than whoever answers the office phone.
buyingWindow: May-Jun (grad night), Nov-Dec (winter formal), Feb (booster banquets)
headcountBasis: Class-event and booster-banquet scale at a comprehensive high school of roughly two thousand; the senior class alone is several hundred. Estimate only.
note: The email on file reaches the principal. The role to work is the Assistant Principal of Student Affairs, named on the same page but published without an address.
addressSource: School principal page on fullertonhigh.org, read 14 August 2026

name: Buena Park High School
orgTypeBasis: A comprehensive public high school operated by Fullerton Joint Union High School District, listed on the district's school index with its own site.
whyTheyFit: Buena Park's Student Leadership page publishes two named advisors with addresses - one for ASB and one for Link Crew - and Link Crew is the freshman-transition program, which means this campus buys twice a year on two different clocks: a welcome event for incoming ninth graders in August and the senior calendar in spring, the August half landing in exactly the pre-opening window a new venue needs to fill.
buyingWindow: Jul-Aug (Link Crew freshman welcome), May-Jun (grad night and senior events)
headcountBasis: Link Crew orientations run to the whole incoming class, several hundred; ASB-run evening events are smaller. Estimate only.
note: Farthest school on this list at just over six miles, and the only one in Buena Park - worth pairing with any other call out that way rather than a dedicated trip.

name: Placentia-Yorba Linda Unified School District
orgTypeBasis: A California unified school district; its own school directory page lists 21 elementary, 6 middle, 5 high and 4 alternative schools plus preschools.
whyTheyFit: PYLUSD publishes a single school directory listing 36 sites with street addresses and phone numbers, and three of its high schools are already on this board - so the district office on Orangethorpe is the one address that converts three existing campus relationships into a standing approved-vendor line the other 33 sites can draw on, including six middle schools that promote an eighth-grade class every June.
buyingWindow: Aug-Oct (vendor approval), May-Jun (site-level promotion and grad events)
headcountBasis: A GROUP SIZE, not the district. A district-office staff appreciation or leadership night runs roughly 60-150; the estimated 22,000-27,000 students across 36 sites are the downstream reason to be an approved vendor, not the guest list. Both figures are estimates.
note: Its own published school directory is the best single source document in this whole segment - every site with address and phone on one page. Estimated enrolment 22,000-27,000 across 36 sites.
addressSource: District homepage and CDE School Directory record 30666470000000, both read 14 August 2026

name: Kraemer Middle School
orgTypeBasis: A public middle school of Placentia-Yorba Linda Unified, listed on the district's school directory and in the CDE directory.
whyTheyFit: Kraemer states over a thousand students and lists ASB Student Leadership, marching band, dance team, colour guard, Science Olympiad and 45-plus clubs on one campus, plus Bridge classes that feed Valencia High - so the eighth-grade promotion celebration here is a rehearsal for a relationship that follows the same families up to a high school already on this board.
buyingWindow: May-Jun (eighth-grade promotion and end-of-year rewards), Dec (band and activity socials)
headcountBasis: An eighth-grade cohort at a 1,000-plus middle school runs roughly 300-350; individual club and band groups are 30-80. Estimate only, built off the enrolment the school states on its homepage.
note: Middle schools buy daytime and early-evening, which is inventory a venue struggles to sell to adults.
addressSource: School homepage, PYLUSD school directory and CDE record 30666476030043, all read 14 August 2026

name: El Camino Real Continuation High School
orgTypeBasis: Carried in the CDE school directory under the educational program type 'Continuation School', operated by Placentia-Yorba Linda Unified.
whyTheyFit: A state-designated continuation school sitting on the same block as the PYLUSD district office, which means credit recovery on a rolling calendar rather than one June ceremony - small graduating groups several times a year, the kind of twenty-to-forty booking that fills a Tuesday afternoon and that no comprehensive high school will ever ask for.
buyingWindow: Rolling - small completion ceremonies through the year, heaviest Dec and Jun
headcountBasis: Continuation high schools in Orange County typically enrol 100-250 total and graduate in small cohorts. Estimate only, based on the school type the state assigns it, not a reported roll.
note: Its street address is 50 metres from the PYLUSD district office - one visit reaches both.

name: Sunny Hills High School
orgTypeBasis: A comprehensive public high school operated by Fullerton Joint Union High School District, listed on the district's school index and in the CDE directory.
whyTheyFit: Sunny Hills runs its athletics department on its own separate domain and staffs it with an athletic director, four AD assistants and a trainer, all six published with addresses - a department that large is running enough teams that end-of-season banquets are a recurring purchase rather than a favour, and the AD is the one buyer here who already has an events budget.
buyingWindow: Nov (fall sports banquets), Feb-Mar (winter banquets), May-Jun (spring banquets and grad night)
headcountBasis: A single-sport team banquet with families runs 30-90; the school as a whole is roughly two thousand. Estimate only.
note: Best-staffed athletics contact found in the whole K-12 pass - six named addresses on one page - and the row still cannot be pinned. Worth resolving with a Places or parcel lookup before the map ships.
addressSource: School homepage and CDE record 30665143037348, both read 14 August 2026, which agree on 1801 Lancer Way
excludeReason: No coordinate. The Census geocoder returns nothing for 1801 Lancer Way in Fullerton, with or without the postcode, although both the school's own site and the state directory print that address. The same number on Warburton Way - the street's former name, which the school no longer uses - does return a coordinate about a mile and a half north-west of downtown Fullerton, and it is almost certainly the same campus, but borrowing a superseded street name's pin is exactly the invented coordinate this board refuses. The contact on this row is the strongest of the six FJUHSD campuses, so treat it as a call rather than a pin.
